answer:
Your Habits note now has a tracker page.

- **Data:** I turned your daily entries from 28 Sep to 4 Oct into a table. It has a row per day and a column each for Walk, Read, Stretch and No phone in bed. I kept your "too tired" and "party" remarks as a line under the table.
- **Daily ticking:** Today's habits are big tap targets. Tapping one ticks it, and tapping it again unticks it. Each habit shows how many days in a row you've done it.
- **Weekly goals:** The "This week" section has a progress bar for each habit. You can type a days-per-week goal into the box beside each one. I haven't set any goals for you.
- **14-day grid:** A grid shows which habits you did on each of the last 14 days.

Today's row doesn't exist yet. The first tick you make today will add it.

Two streaks may look shorter than you expect:

- **Walk:** your last walk was 3 Oct, so with no walk on 4 Oct and none yet today, the streak is 0.
- **Read:** you read on 4 Oct, so the streak shows as 1 now and will count today once you tick it.
